instruction: Update the yellow triangle's color to blue.

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the yellow triangle to blue color. The evaluator exports the image and uses computer vision to detect the triangle shape and verify its color changed from yellow to blue. The getter retrieves both the result and original images. The metric uses OpenCV contour detection to: 1) find the yellow triangle in the original image to get its location and size, 2) find blue regions in the result image, 3) verify that a blue triangle-like shape (3-5 vertices) exists in approximately the same location, and 4) confirm the color is truly blue (B > R+30 AND B > G+30 AND B > 100).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies both requirements: triangle shape preserved and color changed to blue
Getter properly extracts both result and original images for comparison
Metric uses robust computer vision logic (OpenCV contour detection) to identify triangle shape and verify color
Location verification ensures the blue triangle is in the same location as original yellow triangle (within 50 pixels)
Color verification uses proper thresholds (B > R+30 AND B > G+30 AND B > 100) to confirm true blue color
Shape verification uses contour approximation (3-5 vertices) which is appropriate for triangle detection
Handles edge cases: missing files, empty data, works even without original image
Postconfig correctly exports the image using GIMP shortcut (Shift+Ctrl+E) so verification can access the file
No parameter handling errors - metric correctly uses expected parameter without accessing non-existent keys
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Original image path is hardcoded in getter (/home/user/Desktop/Triangle_On_The_Side.png) - could be more flexible by deriving from config
Tolerance values (50 pixels for location, 50% for size) are reasonable but somewhat arbitrary - could be parameterized
